messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have the latest statistics on hand. For the most accurate and up‑to‑date information on the Premier League’s top assist provider, you can check the official Premier League website or reputable sports databases such as Opta, WhoScored, or Transfermarkt.

There's a tool function: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer but that's for top scorer. There's no function for assists. So we cannot use the function. We can answer based on knowledge. But we might not have up-to-date data. The question is ambiguous: "most assist player" could mean current or historically. Likely they want the current top assist provider. As of 2025? We don't know. We can say "As of the last completed season (2023/24), the top assist provider was ...". But we don't have that data. We can provide a general answer: "As of the 2022/23 season, the top assist provider was ...". But we don't know. We can say "I don't have the exact data." But we can guess: In 2022/23, the top assist provider was Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) with 18 assists. In 2023/24, maybe it's still Bruno. But we can't guarantee.

We can respond: "I don't have the exact data. You can check official Premier League stats." That would be safe.
